ua.stetsenkoinna.theme
 
  • Classes in ua.stetsenkoinna.theme used by ua.stetsenkoinna.config
    Class
    Description
    ThemeMode
    The appearance setting as the user chooses it, which is not the same thing as the appearance that ends up on screen: ThemeMode.SYSTEM has no look of its own, it defers to the desktop and can therefore mean either of the other two depending on the machine the app is started on.
  • Classes in ua.stetsenkoinna.theme used by ua.stetsenkoinna.theme
    Class
    Description
    CanvasColor
    The roles a colour can play in the net drawing.
    CanvasPalette
    Every colour the net drawing uses, in one place, so that switching the application between light and dark is a matter of swapping one object rather than hunting literals through the painters.
    ThemeMode
    The appearance setting as the user chooses it, which is not the same thing as the appearance that ends up on screen: ThemeMode.SYSTEM has no look of its own, it defers to the desktop and can therefore mean either of the other two depending on the machine the app is started on.
    ThemeVariant
    An appearance that can actually be painted, as opposed to ThemeMode, which is what the user picked and may still be a deferral.
